rows.published_source: Czimmerer Z, et al. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (hsa-mir-155): RT GTTGGCTCTGGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACCAGAGCCAACACCCCT, forward GTGGGTTAATGCTAATCGTGAT. Also Yang L-h, et al. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293: forward GCGGTTAATGCTAATCGTGATA (same miRNA-specific core; different USLP body). Forward-core comparison only. NOTE — overhang NOT scored: both papers anchor the RT primer on the older 23-nt mature miR-155 (3' end ...AGGGGU; Czimmerer overhang ACCCCT; Yang 8-nt ACCCCTAT), whereas miRBase v22 / this tool's database annotate hsa-miR-155-5p as 24 nt (3' end ...GGGGUU), giving overhang AACCCC. This is a reference-annotation difference, not a design error — but it means a primer ordered from the 2013/2014 papers binds a 1-nt-shifted 3' end.
